### Pages Directory

- Has navigation button to blog page

**pages/_app.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/_app.js) - App Wrapper
- Wraps application with `AppProvider` context
- Renders layout with header, navigation, main content area, and footer
- Imports global styles from `globals.css`
- Navigation links to Home (/) and Blog (/blog)

**pages/_document.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/_document.js) - HTML Document
- Sets up HTML structure with language attribute
- Includes meta description and favicon
- Loads Google Fonts (Inter font family)

**pages/_error.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/_error.js) - Error Page Handler
- Handles both server-side and client-side errors
- Uses `getInitialProps` to get status code
- Displays different messages based on status code

**pages/404.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/404.js) - Custom 404 Page
- Custom 404 error page
- Displays "404 - Page Not Found" message
- Button to return to home page

**pages/blog/index.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/blog/index.js) - Blog Index
- Uses `getStaticProps` with ISR (60-second revalidation)
- Fetches all posts from JSONPlaceholder API
- Displays posts in a grid layout with truncated content preview
- Each post card has "Read More" button linking to individual post

**pages/blog/[id].js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/blog/[id].js) - Blog Post Detail
- Uses `getStaticPaths` and `getStaticProps` for static generation
- Pre-generates paths for first 10 posts
- Uses fallback: 'blocking' for other posts
- Fetches post data and comments from JSONPlaceholder API
- 5-minute ISR revalidation
- Displays post with all comments
- Back button to return to previous page

---

### API Routes

**pages/api/posts/index.js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/api/posts/index.js) - Posts List API
- GET: Returns simulated posts array
- POST: Creates new post (requires title and content)
- Returns 400 if title or content missing
- Returns 201 for successful post creation

**pages/api/posts/[id].js** (/vercel/sandbox/pages/api/posts/[id].js) - Individual Post API
- GET: Retrieves single post by ID
- PUT: Updates post (requires title and/or content)
- DELETE: Deletes post by ID
- Returns 405 for unsupported methods

---

### Components

**components/AppProvider.js** (/vercel/sandbox/components/AppProvider.js)
```javascript
import { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';

const AppContext = createContext();

export function AppProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');

  return (
    <AppContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </AppContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAppContext() {
  const context = useContext(AppContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAppContext must be used within AppProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```
- Context provider for theme management
- Currently manages theme state (light/dark)
- Provides custom hook `useAppContext()` for accessing context

---

### Styles

**styles/globals.css** (/vercel/sandbox/styles/globals.css) - Global Styles
- Reset styles (box-sizing, margin, padding)
- Body font: Inter (from Google Fonts)
- App container: max-width 1200px, centered
- Header with border-bottom
- Navigation links styled in blue (#0070f3)
- Posts grid: responsive layout (auto-fit, minmax 300px)
- Post cards: border, padding, rounded corners
- Comments section: styled comment blocks
- Error page: centered layout with large typography
- Button styling: blue background with hover effects

---

### Key Features Summary

1. **Next.js Pages Router** - Using traditional pages/ directory structure (not App Router)
2. **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)** - Home page uses getServerSideProps
3. **Static Generation (SSG)** - Blog pages use getStaticProps and getStaticPaths
4. **Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)** - Blog pages revalidate periodically
5. **API Routes** - RESTful API endpoints for posts management
6. **Context API** - Global theme management via AppProvider
7. **External API Integration** - JSONPlaceholder API for demo data
8. **Custom Error Handling** - _error.js and 404.js pages
9. **TypeScript Support** - tsconfig.json configured for TS/TSX
10. **Latest Dependencies** - React 19, Next.js 16 canary, AI SDK integrations

### No app/ Directory
This project uses the **Pages Router** architecture exclusively. There is no app/ directory for App Router.
